Yes.  It’s raining! 🌧️ That in itself is a traffic advisory.  

However, 

Expect delays on Figueroa between Venice Blvd and Olympic Blvd.  All lanes of traffic will be affected due to a special event in the area.  Sidewalks are closed, west side.

Filipinos flocked to Binondo in Manila on New Year’s Eve for their last-minute shopping, specifically to buy some lucky charms to welcome 2026 or the “Year of the Fire Horse.”

According to JP Soriano’s report in “24 Oras” on Wednesday, lucky charms designed with horse figures are a hit with customers.
